1.web: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
1.asv: Yea, at this my heart trembleth, And is moved out of its place.

2.web: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
2.asv: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, And the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

3.web: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
3.asv: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, And his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

4.web: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
4.asv: After it a voice roareth; He thundereth with the voice of his majesty; And he restraineth not the lightnings when his voice is heard.

5.web: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
5.asv: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; Great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

6.web: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth;’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
6.asv: For he saith to the snow, Fall thou on the earth; Likewise to the shower of rain, And to the showers of his mighty rain.

7.web: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
7.asv: He sealeth up the hand of every man, That all men whom he hath made may know it.

8.web: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
8.asv: Then the beasts go into coverts, And remain in their dens.

9.web: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
9.asv: Out of the chamberof the south cometh the storm, And cold out of the north.

10.web: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the breadth of the waters is frozen.
10.asv: By the breath of God ice is given; And the breadth of the waters is straitened.

11.web: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
11.asv: Yea, he ladeth the thick cloud with moisture; He spreadeth abroad the cloud of his lightning:

12.web: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
12.asv: And it is turned round about by his guidance, That they may do whatsoever he commandeth them Upon the face of the habitable world,

13.web: Whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
13.asv: Whether it be for correction, or for his land, Or for lovingkindness, that he cause it to come.

14.web: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
14.asv: Hearken unto this, O Job: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

15.web: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
15.asv: Dost thou know how God layeth his charge upon them, And causeth the lightning of his cloud to shine?

16.web: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
16.asv: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

17.web: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
17.asv: How thy garments are warm, When the earth is still by reason of the southwind?

18.web: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
18.asv: Canst thou with him spread out the sky, Which is strong as a molten mirror?

19.web: Teach us what we shall tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
19.asv: Teach us what we shall say unto him; For we cannot set our speech in order by reason of darkness.

20.web: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
20.asv: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

21.web: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
21.asv: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind passeth, and cleareth them.

22.web: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
22.asv: Out of the north cometh golden splendor: God hath upon him terrible majesty.

23.web: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
23.asv: Touchingthe Almighty, we cannot find him out: He is excellent in power; And in justice and plenteous righteousness he will not afflict.

24.web: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
24.asv: Men do therefore fear him: He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.
